title: CBN official-register financial-institution directory
methodologyNote: CBN does not publish one consolidated dated historical file for 31 July 2026. The requested date is therefore an analytical cutoff, not a claim that every row was independently verified on that date. Undated live CBN registers support listed-at-retrieval status and retain their retrieval timestamp. The BDC tier split is reconciled to CBN's dated final-licence notice effective 27 November 2025. The known 46 MFB revocations effective 1 July 2026 are documented as a population-level change, but the live list alone does not prove historical presence for every MFB row. Confirm status against CBN before regulatory reliance; records marked legacy-listed especially require current-status confirmation.
namingNote: Category and authorisation labels preserve current CBN web-register nomenclature. Institution display names preserve CBN spellings except two reviewed HTML anomalies; those records retain rawName and sourceAnomaly. Whitespace and punctuation spacing are normalized without stripping legitimate leading digits.
recordModelNote: Rows are source register or authorisation listings, not a deduplicated count of legal entities. The same institution may legitimately appear under multiple CBN registers or authorisations. Distinct-register-name and source-listing counts are reported separately.
